fields.phoneHint: With the country code if not Colombian (+1, +34…).
fields.vipHint: Highlighted in arrivals and on the calendar.

reasons.phone_name: Same phone and similar last name

form.description: These details appear on reservations, at check-in and in legal reports (TRA, SIRE).
form.consentLabel: Authorized the processing of their personal data
form.consentHint: Colombian data protection law 1581 of 2012 (Habeas Data). We keep the date of the authorization.
form.exists: A guest with that document already exists.
form.duplicatesTitle: Is it one of these people?
form.duplicatesHint: We found profiles with similar details. Open the existing one instead of creating a new one.

detail.mergedBanner: This profile was merged into another one. Its information now lives in the main profile.
detail.anonymizedBanner: Personal data was anonymized on {{date}}. Reservations are kept without data that identifies the guest.

stats.spentHint: Charges of their reservations as booker, VAT included, across all hotels.

consent.title: Habeas Data
consent.subtitle: Authorization to process personal data (Colombian law 1581 of 2012).
consent.revokeDescription: The guest can keep booking, but their data will only be used to manage their stay.

duplicates.banner_one: We found {{count}} profile that could be this same person.
duplicates.banner_other: We found {{count}} profiles that could be this same person.
duplicates.askManager: Ask a manager to review and merge them.

merge.title: Merge profiles
merge.description: Choose the profile to keep. Reservations, stays, folios and documents of the other one move to it, and its empty details are filled in.
merge.keepNote: The merged profile stays in the history and no longer shows up in searches.

anonymize.title: Anonymize {{name}}'s data
anonymize.description: Name, document, contact details, notes, preferences and identity files are erased. Reservations and invoices are kept without personal data. This cannot be undone.

export.done: We downloaded the file with the guest's data

delete.title: Delete this guest?
delete.description: Only guests without reservations or history can be deleted. To handle an erasure request use “Anonymize data”.

documents.empty: No documents. Upload a photo of the ID card or passport.
documents.dropzone: Drop a photo or a PDF here
documents.dropzoneHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF, up to 10 MB. Only team members with guest access can see them.
documents.loadError: We could not open the file.

notes.notesHint: Only the team sees them. Do not write down health data without the guest's consent.
notes.preferencesHint: What makes their stay more comfortable: bed, pillow, floor…
notes.tagsHint: To group and filter: frequent, corporate, honeymoon…
